elements.note: *** THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE IN THE ENTIRE 108-PAGE BOOK A PUBLICATION DATE APPEARS. *** Every individual drawing sheet's title block instead carries 'ม.ค. 2562' (January 2019) as its own drawing date -- so the drawings were finished about five months before the book itself was printed (June 2019).

warnings: *** THIS PAGE NAMES THE OVERARCHING PUBLIC PROGRAM, 'บ้านสานฝัน ของขวัญปีใหม่ คนไทยมีความสุข' (Dream House, New Year Gift, Thai People's Happiness) -- run by กรมโยธาธิการและผังเมือง, กระทรวงมหาดไทย. *** 'บ้านอารยสถาปัตย์ 3', this specific house's name in every BOQ title block, is one design produced under that program (PNG 107 shows there are three: 1, 2 and 3).

Four credited groups: ที่ปรึกษา (7 advisors, department leadership), คณะทำงานกำกับดูแล (10-person oversight committee), คณะทำงานออกแบบและประมาณราคา split into two design bureaus (Architecture, 9 people; Structural/Systems Engineering, 6 people), and คณะทำงานประสานงาน split into two coordination offices (กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง -- the BOQ-pricing office named on every ปร.4 sheet in this book, 10 people; and กองเผยแพร่และประชาสัมพันธ์, publicity, 3 people).

Proper names are transcribed as best legible at this scan resolution and flagged proper_names_ocr_uncertain -- Thai given names with unusual spellings are the likeliest source of transcription error on this page, not a load-bearing technical fact.

*** PUBLICATION DATE: 1st printing, June 2019 (มิถุนายน 2562), printed by บริษัท แอคทีฟ 888 จำกัด. *** This is the only date in the whole book that is not a per-sheet drawing date -- every drawing title block instead says ม.ค. 2562 (January 2019), so the drawing set was complete about five months before this printed compilation.
